attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Nevada Commerce Tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, and revenue threshold.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Nevada Commerce Tax Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence and exceeds threshold
Has economic nexus and exceeds threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold ge and

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below threshold - no Commerce Tax due
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef 0.0 /result.state_tax xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax: No tax due (Nevada gross revenue below $4M threshold). Nevada has NO corporate income tax. The Commerce Tax only applies to businesses with Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4,000,000. Below this threshold, no Commerce Tax is due. Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Commerce Tax Threshold" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax filing required due to physical presence and revenue exceeding $4M. Physical presence includes: office or place of business in Nevada, employees working in Nevada, tangible property in Nevada, Nevada entity (organized under Nevada law), or registered to do business in Nevada. The Commerce Tax is calculated on Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M. Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus, NRS 363C.100 - Tax Imposition" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax filing required due to economic nexus. Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 or more in Nevada-sourced receipts, OR 200 or more separate transactions in Nevada. Nevada adopted economic nexus following South Dakota v. Wayfair (2018). Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Economic Nexus, South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto

true /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef 0.0 /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Nevada nexus - no Commerce Tax filing requirement. Corporation does not have: physical presence in Nevada, $100,000 or more in Nevada receipts, or 200 or more Nevada transactions. Any estimated payments would be refunded. Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus Requirements" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Nevada has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize Nevada income adjustments (none - no income tax)
initial_action.action_postfix: "Nevada Corporate Income Adjustments Check: Nevada has NO corporate income tax" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /result.state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Nevada has NO corporate income tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /result.state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.state_subtractions xdef "Nevada has NO corporate income tax. Nevada does NOT tax corporate net income. Instead, Nevada imposes: Commerce Tax (gross receipts tax on revenue exceeding $4M), Modified Business Tax (payroll tax on employee compensation), and Business License Fee (annual fee). This decision table confirms zero income tax for framework consistency. The Commerce Tax is calculated separately by table 54080. Reference: NRS 363C - Commerce Tax (NOT an income tax), Nevada Constitution Article 10 - No state income tax" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 /result.state_additions xdef 0.0 /result.state_subtractions xdef "No Nevada nexus - no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine Nevada business classification for Commerce Tax rate. Sets appropriate Commerce Tax rate based on industry (NAICS code).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Nevada Business Classification Determination Started" job.audit_trail swap addto result.nv_other_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef

action_details.action_postfix: result.nv_financial_services_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Financial Services: 0.331%. NAICS Code 52 - Finance and Insurance includes banks, credit unions, securities dealers, insurance carriers, and other financial institutions. This is the highest Commerce Tax rate classification. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_mining_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Mining: 0.262%. NAICS Code 21 - Mining, Quarrying, and Oil and Gas Extraction includes metal ore mining, coal mining, oil and gas extraction, and mining support. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_utilities_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Utilities: 0.266%. NAICS Code 22 - Utilities includes electric power, natural gas, water, and sewage utilities. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_professional_services_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Professional, Scientific, Technical Services: 0.128%. NAICS Code 54 - Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services includes legal, accounting, engineering, consulting, computer systems design, and other professional services. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_retail_trade_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Retail Trade: 0.091%. NAICS Codes 44-45 - Retail Trade includes motor vehicle dealers, furniture stores, electronics stores, food and beverage stores, and other retail establishments. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_manufacturing_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Manufacturing: 0.091%. NAICS Codes 31-33 - Manufacturing includes production of goods from raw materials through fabrication, processing, assembling, and packaging. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_wholesale_trade_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Wholesale Trade: 0.101%. NAICS Code 42 - Wholesale Trade includes merchant wholesalers, agents and brokers selling goods to retailers, business/institutional customers, or other wholesalers. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

result.nv_other_rate /result.nv_commerce_tax_rate xdef "Nevada Commerce Tax - Other Services: 0.051% (lowest rate). Catch-all classification for business activities not specifically classified in other NAICS categories. Reference: NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates, NAC 363C.100 - Business Category Classification" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Nevada-sitused gross revenue for Commerce Tax. Uses market-based sourcing to determine revenue attributable to Nevada.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Nevada Sitused Revenue Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef 0.0 /result.nv_gross_revenue xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and has apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_receipts result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.apportionment_percentage 0 gt and

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus but no apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_receipts result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.apportionment_percentage 0 eq and

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Nevada-sitused revenue using market-based sourcing
action_details.action_postfix: result.total_revenue result.apportionment_percentage mul /result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef result.nv_sitused_revenue /result.nv_gross_revenue xdef "Nevada sitused revenue calculation for Commerce Tax: Nevada uses market-based sourcing (destination-based) to determine what revenue is sitused to Nevada: Sales of tangible property (destination state), Services (where customer receives benefit), Intangible property/licenses (where customer uses intangible), Rental income (location of rented property). Only revenue sitused to Nevada is subject to Commerce Tax. The $4M threshold applies to Nevada-sitused revenue only. Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Situsing Gross Revenue, NAC 363C.200 - Situsing Rules, NAC 363C.220 - Market-Based Sourcing" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No apportionment - assume 100% Nevada if nexus exists
action_details.action_postfix: result.total_revenue /result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef result.total_revenue /result.nv_gross_revenue xdef "No apportionment percentage calculated - treating all receipts as Nevada-sitused. This is conservative approach when apportionment data is unavailable" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No Nevada nexus - no revenue sitused to Nevada
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.nv_sitused_revenue xdef 0.0 /result.nv_gross_revenue xdef "No Nevada nexus - no revenue sitused to Nevada" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Nevada Commerce Tax liability. Applies Commerce Tax rate to Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M. IMPORTANT: This is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Nevada Commerce Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.nv_taxable_revenue xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold ge and
result.has_physical_presence_nv result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold ge or result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold lt and

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Commerce Tax on taxable revenue
action_details.action_postfix:
result.nv_gross_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_threshold sub 0 max /result.nv_taxable_revenue xdef
result.nv_taxable_revenue result.nv_commerce_tax_rate mul /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef
result.nv_commerce_tax result.state_credits sub 0 max /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef
result.nv_commerce_tax /result.state_tax xdef
result.state_payments result.state_tax sub /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"Nevada Commerce Tax Calculation: IMPORTANT - Nevada has NO corporate income tax. The Commerce Tax is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax. Process: 1) Nevada-sitused gross revenue, 2) Commerce Tax threshold: -$4,000,000, 3) Taxable revenue = excess over threshold, 4) Business classification determines rate (0.051%-0.331%), 5) Commerce Tax before credits, 6) Credits applied (renewable energy, data center, film, aviation, etc.), 7) Final Commerce Tax liability. Key Differences from Income Tax: Based on GROSS RECEIPTS (revenue) not net income, No deductions for expenses/COGS/operating costs, $4M threshold, Very low rates (0.051%-0.331%) but on gross revenue, Must be paid even if business operates at a loss. Reference: NRS 363C.100 - Commerce Tax Imposition, NRS 363C.110 - Tax Rates by Industry, NRS 363C.150 - Credits, Form CT-1 - Commerce Tax Return" job.audit_trail swap addto

true /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.nv_taxable_revenue xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef 0.0 /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Nevada Commerce Tax due - Nevada-sitused revenue below $4M threshold. Nevada has NO corporate income tax. The Commerce Tax only applies to businesses with Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4,000,000. Revenue below this threshold is exempt from Commerce Tax. Note: Other Nevada taxes may still apply: Business License Fee (annual fee), Modified Business Tax (payroll tax on wages), Sales and Use Tax (on retail sales). Any estimated Commerce Tax payments would be refunded. Reference: NRS 363C.100 - $4M Threshold Exemption, NRS 363C.110 - Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto

true /result.nv_qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.nv_taxable_revenue xdef 0.0 /result.nv_commerce_tax xdef 0.0 /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No Nevada nexus - no Commerce Tax liability. Corporation does not have: physical presence in Nevada, $100,000 or more in Nevada receipts, or 200 or more Nevada transactions. Any estimated payments are refunded. Reference: NRS 363C.040 - Nexus Requirements" job.audit_trail swap addto
